method.buildingDimensions: Building.width × depth are parcel-envelope dimensions. The renderer sets structures back and uses kind/profile-specific massing.
method.interpretation: Coverage and FAR are nominal parcel-envelope proxies, not actual rendered building footprint or usable floor area.
method.aggregation: Areas sum clipped nominal envelopes; overlapping envelopes are counted separately rather than unioned.
method.rotation: Nominal parcel rectangles use Building.rotation (Three.js Y convention); missing rotation defaults to zero. Cell and world clipping use the rotated polygon.
method.occupancy: Building.occupancy counts residents in housing; it does not determine commercial activity.
method.commercialActivity: Open commercial buildings use business_active: true means active, false means vacant, and a missing value (as in legacy saves) means unknown.

denominator: gross area of world.bounds, including water and protected land
